title: Classical Buildings as Self-Dual Lattice Functions
body_html:
Classical Buildings as Self-Dual Lattice Functions

For a classical group \(G=U(V)\), the Bruhat-Tits building \(B(G,k)\) is naturally identified with the set of splittable self-dual lattice functions on \(V\). Under this identification, if \(x\) corresponds to \(L\), then the lattice-function filtrations agree with the Moy-Prasad filtrations.
proof_html: The theorem is used as a translation device: building-theoretic conditions can be checked by explicit lattice-function calculations, and lattice-function filtrations can be read as Moy-Prasad filtrations.
